name: Babel
description: Translate the Drupal user interface (code strings, configuration, and simple content entities) from a single unified interface.
project_description: Babel is an open-architecture module that enables the translation of all Drupal UI strings, whether they originate from code (Locale) or from configuration. Unlike the Locale module alone, Babel is not limited to configuration strings shipped with core or contrib; it exposes all translatable strings through a single unified interface aimed at non-technical translators. Babel stores no translations of its own — it acts as a hub that reads and writes each string back to its native backend (locale tables, configuration storage, content entities) via a pluggable 'translation type' system. It ships Locale and Config translation-type plugins, a Spreadsheet import/export data-transfer plugin (xlsx/xls/ods/csv, via phpoffice/phpspreadsheet), a curated per-string activation model, and translation locking so manual translations are never overwritten by imports or automation. Submodules add content-entity translation (babel_content_entity), custom menu link translation (babel_menu_link_content), and a TMGMT source plugin (babel_tmgmt) that feeds the curated strings to translation providers.
